messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PD#246789 triggered: embeddings-queue latency > 95th pct for 3m, region-eu. Auto-page to oncall. Links: https://pd.example/incidents/246789

dave-oncall: acked PD#246789 :white_check_mark: taking it now. I'm on the bridge.

alice: thanks — any customer-visible errors yet?

dave-oncall: 502s for some embedding requests, traffic spike from nightly batch. Not full outage but tail latency is bad.

ben: adding context — we saw a 3x enqueue on embeddings-worker in eu-west-1, approx 200k extra messages in Redis list. Possibly duplicate producer job.

carol: can we throttle or pause the batch producer? Who controls the job?

alice: batch job owner is @data-pipelines (jenkins job: embed-batch-eu). I've DM'ed the owner to pause.

ben: meanwhile we can scale the embeddings workers and enable fallback model to reduce per-request latency.

sre-runbook-bot: Runbook: Embeddings queue high latency -> 1) scale replicas 2) flush consumer backlog with safe drain 3) enable read-only fallback to smaller model. See runbook: https://runbook.internal/emb-queue-latency

carol: commands to run:```bash
# scale workers
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/emb-worker-eu --replicas=8
# enable fallback route
curl -X POST "https://internal-api/route-config" -d '{"route":"embeddings","fallback_model":"embed-small-v2"}'
```

dave-oncall: executing scale now. Pasting logs:```kubectl scale deploy/emb-worker-eu --replicas=8
deployment.apps/emb-worker-eu scaled
```

alice: paused the batch job (confirmed) :hand: should reduce incoming load in ~2m.

ben: starting a controlled backlog drain — will monitor queue depth.

carol: enabling fallback now. Expect slight quality drop but huge latency gains.

incident-bot: Config change event recorded: route-config updated by carol (fallback_model embed-small-v2). Audit ID: cfg_88a2.

ben: queue depth: 198k -> 120k after pause+scale (30s). Good trend.

dave-oncall: seeing 95th pct latency drop 2.3s -> 650ms in dashboards. Still some 5xx but declining.

alice: customer impact summary for comms: some API requests returned 502 between 12:13-12:22 UTC, estimated 0.8% of requests in EU region. No data loss, retries succeeded.

ben: mitigation holding. Suggest keeping fallback enabled for 15m and then validate replay.
dave-oncall: agreed. I'll own the bridge for the next 20m then hand to ben for postmortem and follow-up with data-pipelines.

carol: leaving a note: will prepare rollback steps for fallback and replica scale.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PD#246789 status updated to "acknowledged" by dave-oncall. Timeline events logged.

ben: taking handoff in 18m for post-incident — I'll open a follow-up ticket to root cause (duplicate producer job), CC: data-pipelines, infra.

alice: customer comm draft: "We experienced elevated latency for embeddings in EU between 12:13–12:22 UTC. Most requests succeeded after automatic fallback; a small subset received errors. We're investigating and will follow up." I'll post if we have no objections.

dave-oncall: no objections. Posting draft once we confirm final numbers.

carol: leaving final checklist: 1) ensure batch job paused 2) confirm queue drained <10k 3) revert fallback after canary check 4) postmortem ticket.

ben: queue depth now 9.8k, 95th latency stable at ~420ms. Marking mitigation successful.

dave-oncall: handing to ben — I'm stepping out to a meeting. Ben, you're owner for next 2 hours.

ben: accepted. I'll run the RCA and coordinate with data-pipelines. Closing the immediate incident chat. :slightly_smiling_face:

incident-bot: PD#246789 bridge closed by dave-oncall; incident marked acknowledged -> mitigation in progress.

sre-runbook-bot: Post-incident checklist created: RCF-246789. Reminder: collect producer logs, exact enqueue timestamps, and overlay autoscaler metrics.

alice: thanks team. Summary and next steps in the follow-up ticket. :pray:
